The [migration snapshot](history/production-readiness-2026-11-14.md) retains all detailed implementation evidence, reservations, accepted scope and historical review dates. Its current boundary details remain applicable unless an explicit later decision supersedes them.

Development verification uses reproducible synthetic evidence and the proportional [solo-developer workflow](../ai/solo-developer-workflow.md). Production certification is a separate release decision. An implementation-complete row is not a certified release.

**Release gate:** Every P0 row must be complete on the same release commit. The supported deployment, authentication, tenancy, storage, provider, browser and WPF envelope must be explicit; unsupported paths fail closed. Retain signed artifact/lifecycle, recovery, operator and required GitHub Actions evidence. Historical green runs do not certify later changes.

**Open P0 release requirements:** 21.

Implementation states below preserve the recorded source/candidate grades; `open` means the parent item remains open. Release status is tracked independently.
